title: Lena and the Promise
author: Petra Ravensworth
blurb: Tamsin Amberdale, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
